verdict: A clinical case study in tenured exhaustion and zero sartorial remorse.
detailedQuote: This professor is rocking the exact outfit energy of someone who replies 'please refer to syllabus' to every single urgent student email. The orthopedic sneakers scream 'I have a bad back', but the tucked-in button-down screams 'I will fail you for being one minute late'.

inventory.name: Whiteboard-Smudged Tenure-Track Shirt
inventory.description: A button-down that has survived 400 wash cycles and still somehow smells like dry-erase markers and institutional despair.

inventory.name: Syllabus Compliance Trousers
inventory.description: Wrinkled pleated khakis strictly preserved since their dissertation defense in 2012.

inventory.name: 3000-Step Lecture Hall Stompers
inventory.description: Orthopedic grey sneakers engineered specifically for pacing back and forth while ignoring raised hands.

inventory.name: Department Keycard Lanyard of Doom
inventory.description: Frayed 2018 hackathon lanyard weighed down by 14 mysterious master keys to locked lab closets.
